article_summaries.title: Nuevo comercial de TV de Free Realms (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official Free Realms news post, captured June 2011, announcing a new Free Realms TV commercial and pointing readers to the video below the text or to the Free Realms Online YouTube channel. The commercial is described as showing biking, building new houses, showing off new outfits, and farming. The post gives no date beyond a relative timestamp and no game mechanics or numbers.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
